title: koanophyllon monanthum
intro: Koanophyllon monanthum, commonly known as yellow-flowering tree, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Koanophyllon monanthum include antiviral, antioxidant, and antiulcer activities. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, however more research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
